# 2026-05-26 - Official Source Excerpts Review Tracking

## Summary

Added review tracking and currentness warnings for official source excerpt records.

## Changes

- Added `OfficialSourceDocument`.
- Added `OfficialSourceReviewLog`.
- Added `OfficialSourceService`.
- Added `/official-sources`.
- Added warnings for not-current records and records with retrieved or revision dates older than 12 months.

- Added tests and documentation.
